_comment: Static scoring tables for 9r-tuner. Bands are hand-assigned, not computed: SWE-bench alone cannot separate Sonnet-5 (72.7 verified) from Haiku-4.5 (73.3 verified). Scores recorded as justification. Review this file rather than trusting the script to infer tiers.

quotaGroup._comment: Prefixes in one named group share one quota/failure domain regardless of provider prefix (cx and ocg are one OpenAI Codex subscription; if one 429s, the other already exhausted). Absent prefixes use their own prefix as group. With quotaScope, key = group for account, group/family for family, group/model for model.

_comboDepth._comment: How many bands BELOW the target band a combo may fall back to. 0 = strict, only the target band. Odin is 1 because only 2 fable-band models exist and both sit on one account (cx); strict would kill Odin whenever codex quota dies. Sleipnir is 1 because it is the system's last-resort tier where availability beats purity. Fenrir and Valkyrie are strict: they have 8 and 12 target-band members respectively and do not need the crutch.

_comboRequires._comment: Capability flags a model must have (from /v1/models capabilities) to be eligible for this combo. A model whose capabilities are unknown - not present in /v1/models - is treated as NOT having the capability, so it is excluded. Currently EMPTY for all combos: the user cleared the vision requirement on 2026-08-01 to regain depth, accepting that an image request may land on a non-vision model. Re-enable by setting a combo's list back to ["vision"].

gpt-5.6-terra.note: Fenrir Codex fallback; approximately gpt-5.5 quality

gpt-5.6-luna.note: cheapest latency-optimised tier of gpt-5.6 family

nemotron-3-ultra.note: coding-strong but agentic-weak; must never head an agentic combo

nemotron-3-super.note: ollama id lacks the -120b-a12b suffix; live 200

costClass._comment: 0=free or free-with-quota, 2=subscription (finite paid allowance, must be preserved). Lower sorts first. Confirmed by the user 2026-08-01: the ONLY subscription providers are ag, cmc, cx, ocg. Rate-limited free tiers (gcli rolling 24h, ollama weekly, kr/gemini daily) need no separate class - their 429s drive health down and the scorer sinks them automatically.

quotaScope._comment: account = one shared pool, all models die together. family = one pool per model family within the provider (antigravity meters anthropic and gemini separately). model = per base model. Default when a prefix is absent is account (safe assumption).

_costOverride._comment: Per-model cost class, checked BEFORE the costClass prefix lookup. TokenRouter exposes 108 upstream models but only these two are free (user-confirmed 2026-08-01: 'token router is basically free model on 2 that i registered... the rest are paying'). The tokenrouter prefix therefore has NO costClass entry and falls to the default 3 (most expensive, sorts last); only these two ids are priced 0.

_bottomPrefixes._comment: Providers that always sort last in every combo regardless of score/health. These are duplicate deepseek accounts (cmc, ocg) we keep for backup but should never burn quota while other providers work.
